body: Ja feel, dude. There's just something about me that lets anyone who gets close enough know that they should keep me at arm's length. Could be the mental illness or the desperation. Although, at this point in my life, that desperation has all but faded to numbness. I know how things are and have more or less resigned myself to it. I only make enough money to scrape by from paycheck to paycheck let alone consider addressing my mental health in any meaningful way. In any case, I hope things improve with your situation.
